nodes.description: IUniswapV2Router02 instance stored on Jinx and used to perform swaps.
Immutable Uniswap V2 pair address created for this token/WETH.
Boolean reentrancy guard flag indicating a swap is currently executing.
Threshold of token balance held by the contract that triggers an automatic swap, default 10**4 * 10**18.
Mapping marking addresses excluded from transfer fees.
ERC20 total supply state variable.
ERC20 internal balance mapping address => amount.
Ownable owner address, set in constructor from msg.sender.
Jinx constructor: creates the Uniswap pair, stores router/pair, sets exclusions and mints the initial supply to the owner.
Payable receive function that allows the contract to accept ETH.
Overridden ERC20 transfer hook that applies fee logic and triggers contract token swaps to ETH.
Approves and swaps contract-held tokens for ETH through the Uniswap router using block.timestamp as deadline.
Swaps tokens for ETH and forwards the entire contract ETH balance to the owner.
Only-owner function that transfers tokens from the caller to a list of recipients.
Only-owner setter for the swapTokensAtAmount threshold.
Internal ERC20 mint that increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance.
Base ERC20 internal transfer updating _balances for sender and recipient.
Ownable modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender().
Internal ERC20 approval that writes the _allowances mapping.
ERC20 constructor setting token name and symbol.
External ERC20 transfer that calls _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Caller-controlled address read through _msgSender() in transfers, ownership checks and airdrops.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the router swap deadline.
External call to the Uniswap router performing a token-to-ETH swap.
Native ETH value transfer to owner() of the whole contract balance after an external call.
Fee arithmetic computed on the transfer amount using SafeMath mul/div.
Initial supply minting performed in the constructor.
External call to the Uniswap factory that deploys the trading pair.
Sender address parameter of Jinx._transfer.
Recipient address parameter of Jinx._transfer.
Token amount parameter of Jinx._transfer.
balanceOf(address(this)) read inside Jinx._transfer.
Boolean comparing contractTokenBalance to swapTokensAtAmount.
Contract token balance passed into swapAndSendDividends.
Boolean deciding whether a transfer fee is applied.
Fee amount derived from amount.mul(1200).div(10000).
Amount of tokens to swap in swapTokensForEth.
Swap path array [token, WETH] built in swapTokensForEth.
Token amount passed to swapAndSendDividends.
Recipient address array parameter of airdrop.
Amount array parameter of airdrop.
Length of the airdrop address array.
Loop index used in the airdrop for-loop.
Token name parameter of the ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol parameter of the ERC20 constructor.
From address parameter of ERC20._transfer.
To address parameter of ERC20._transfer.

edges.reason: Jinx constructor reads msg.sender through _msgSender() to establish ownership.
_owner is assigned directly from the caller-supplied msg.sender.
onlyOwner reads _owner for the authorization comparison.
onlyOwner reads the caller address via _msgSender().
airdrop is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setSwapAtAmount is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
Jinx constructor invokes the ERC20 constructor with name and symbol.
name_ is stored as the token name in the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ is stored as the token symbol in the ERC20 constructor.
Owner address is marked as fee-excluded in _isExcluded.
Constructor sets _isExcluded for owner() and address(this).
Constructor stores the Uniswap router address in uniswapV2Router.
Constructor stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
Constructor calls the factory to create the trading pair.
Constructor mints the initial token supply.
Initial mint relies on ERC20._mint to create balances.
Initial mint increases the total supply.
_mint adds to _totalSupply.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
ERC20.transfer uses _msgSender() as the sending address.
ERC20.transfer delegates to ERC20._transfer.
sender parameter indices the _balances mapping in ERC20._transfer.
recipient parameter is credited in ERC20._transfer.
amount parameter is added and subtracted in ERC20._transfer balances.
ERC20._transfer writes the updated values into the _balances mapping.
Jinx._transfer calls super._transfer (ERC20._transfer).
from parameter is used in zero-address and pair/owner comparisons.
to parameter is used in the zero-address, pair and owner checks.
amount parameter drives the fee computation and transfers.
contractTokenBalance is read from balanceOf(address(this)) i.e. _balances.
canSwap compares contractTokenBalance with the threshold.
canSwap reads the swapTokensAtAmount state variable.
canSwap opens the branch that calls swapAndSendDividends.
Jinx._transfer invokes swapAndSendDividends when the threshold is met.
The swapping flag guards entry into swapAndSendDividends.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to decide swap and fee behavior.
owner() is compared against from/to inside Jinx._transfer.
sellTokens is read as balanceOf(address(this)) from _balances.
sellTokens is passed as the tokens argument to swapAndSendDividends.
swapAndSendDividends calls swapTokensForEth.
takeFee is derived from the negation of the swapping flag.
_isExcluded lookups can disable takeFee.
takeFee gates the computation of the fees local variable.
fees is computed as amount.mul(1200).div(10000).
The transfer amount feeds the fee multiplication/division operation.
Fee arithmetic executes inside Jinx._transfer.
Result of amount.mul(1200).div(10000) is stored in fees.
fees is subtracted from amount and sent to the contract address.
tokenAmount is the amount approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
path array is used as the swap path in the router call.
uniswapV2Router is used to query WETH and to execute the swap.
block.timestamp is supplied as the router swap deadline.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the external swap call.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve before swapping.
An external router call completes before the contract sends its ETH balance to owner(), so the payout can be re-entered while balance state is being consumed.
swapAndSendDividends transfers address(this).balance to owner() after the external swap.
owner() is the recipient of the ETH balance transfer.
tokens parameter is forwarded to swapTokensForEth.
airdrop transfers tokens from _msgSender() to each recipient.
_user array provides the airdrop recipients.
_amount array provides the airdrop amounts.
len bounds the airdrop loop and the array length check.
i iterates the airdrop arrays.
i indexes the _user array inside the airdrop loop.
i indexes the _amount array inside the airdrop loop.
airdrop calls super._transfer for every entry.
amount parameter is the new threshold written by setSwapAtAmount.
setSwapAtAmount writes the swapTokensAtAmount state variable.
createPair returns the pair address stored in uniswapV2Pair.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from belongs to Jinx._transfer and only indexes its logic.
Parameter to belongs to Jinx._transfer and only indexes its logic.
Parameter amount belongs to Jinx._transfer and drives its fee logic.
Local contractTokenBalance is computed and consumed entirely inside Jinx._transfer.
Local canSwap is a branch condition local to Jinx._transfer.
Local sellTokens is derived from balanceOf inside Jinx._transfer.
Local takeFee is a decision flag local to Jinx._transfer.
Local fees is the direct output of the unsafe arithmetic amount.mul(1200).div(10000).
Parameter tokenAmount is the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
Local path is the swap path consumed by swapTokensForEth.
Parameter tokens is the input forwarded by swapAndSendDividends.
Parameter _user is the recipient list of airdrop.
Parameter _amount is the amount list of airdrop.
Local len is the array length local to airdrop.
Local i is the loop counter local to airdrop.
Parameter name_ is assigned to the token name in the ERC20 constructor.
Parameter symbol_ is assigned to the token symbol in the ERC20 constructor.
Parameter recipient is credited in ERC20._transfer.
